headings.usage: Use Manrope for all headings. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Use Inter for body text, data tables, form inputs, and dashboard density.

primary.description: Emerald Green - Used for primary actions, success states, brand highlights, and energy charts.

secondary.description: Electric Blue - Used for tech elements, interactive states, and secondary CTAs.

accent.description: Amber - Used for warnings, active states, and solar energy highlights.

background.description: Deep Navy for dark mode, pure white for light mode.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-xl to rounded-2xl (12px to 16px) for cards and modals. Buttons rounded-lg or pill-shaped.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows. Light mode: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]. Dark mode: no shadow, rely on 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-slate-900/70) for sticky headers and hero overlay cards. Dashboard cards should be flat solid with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on glass surfaces (border-white/20 light, border-white/10 dark).

marketing.hero: Split layout or full-width with heavy glassmorphism card overlapping the image. Generous spacing (py-24).
marketing.bento_grid: For features/services. Asymmetrical grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12), wide gaps (gap-8).

dashboard.structure: Overview-first, role-based layout. Collapsible left sidebar, top header with global search/actions.
dashboard.grid: High density grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
dashboard.widgets: Top row KPI cards (col-span-1), Main chart (col-span-2 or 3), supporting lists (col-span-1).

motion.marketing: Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered reveals (staggered fade-up), animated stat counters, and hover lifts.
motion.dashboard: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback. Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) for interactive cards.
motion.transitions: Specific transitions like transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300. Do NOT use transition-all.

components.buttons: Modern pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Use explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-green-700 hover:text-white).
components.cards: Cardless or 1px bordered containers for dashboard. For marketing, use overlapping layers.
components.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI forms. Input height h-12 for marketing, h-10 for dashboard.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Ensure tooltips have backdrop blur. Primary chart line color should use #16A34A.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards. Don't use complete transparent backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hybrid fullstack app containing both Marketing pages and Dashboard layouts for RUSHX.
Implement full Light and Dark mode toggling via Tailwind's 'dark' class. The default should be intelligent based on system preference.
Design an engaging Marketing hero section with glassmorphism overlays and background imagery. Tell a premium enterprise brand story.
Use Manrope for all headings to ensure a premium look. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Implement an animated stats counter section (scroll-triggered).
Create the Customer Portal Dashboard with tiered AMC plans (pricing cards) and a service booking flow with a date/time slot picker.
Create the Admin Dashboard showing a leads inbox, pipeline, bookings calendar, and customer catalog.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms for robust automated testing.
Ensure 'lucide-react' icons are used to represent the logo and other visual markers where images aren't provided.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds under text. Always use a blur or semi-solid color to maintain contrast.
universal_guidelines: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid full-screen generic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize reusing pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
